tax.note: 20% final withholding tax on peso deposit interest for individuals (NIRC Sec. 24(B)(1), as amended by CMEPA / RA 12214 from July 1, 2025).

pdic.note: PDIC insures deposits up to PHP 1,000,000 per depositor, per bank (effective March 15, 2025). E-wallet balances are not deposits; only money in the partner bank account is a deposit.

baseline.name: Traditional bank regular savings (BPI Regular Savings example)
baseline.conditions: 0.0625% p.a., earns only when daily balance is at least PHP 5,000; PHP 3,000 to open.

platforms.name: GCash
platforms.holder: CIMB Bank Philippines (GSave is a CIMB bank account opened inside GCash)
platforms.conditions: Base rate. Interest credited monthly. No minimum deposit or maintaining balance. Basic GSave: PHP 50,000 cumulative deposit cap per the CIMB product disclosure; upgraded accounts have higher limits. Rate changed from 2.60% to 2.30% on June 1, 2026.
platforms.pdic: Deposit is with CIMB Bank PH, a bank. The GCash wallet balance itself is not a deposit.
platforms.cons: Lowest base rate on this list; basic account deposit cap.

platforms.name: Maya
platforms.holder: Maya Bank, Inc. (digital bank). Maya Wallet balance is not a deposit.
platforms.conditions: 3% p.a. base on the whole balance, credited daily. Boosts up to 15% p.a. apply only to the first PHP 100,000 and need monthly transaction missions (some tiers for select users only). New-user 15% promo lasts one calendar month after qualifying; promo period stated to end Nov 30, 2026.
platforms.promo_label: Up to 15% p.a. with missions, capped at PHP 100,000
platforms.pdic: Savings sit with Maya Bank, Inc., a digital bank. Wallet balance is not a deposit. Confirm PDIC cover in app.
platforms.best_for: Heavy Maya spenders who hit missions every month
platforms.cons: Boosted rate needs spending every month and caps at PHP 100,000. Do not spend just to chase a rate.

platforms.name: GoTyme Bank
platforms.conditions: Up to 5 GoalSaves, no missions per GoTyme. Interest paid monthly, subject to 20% withholding tax.
platforms.pdic: GoTyme's savings page states savings are insured by PDIC. Confirm limits in app.

platforms.name: Tonik
platforms.conditions: Solo Stash 3.25% p.a. Group Stash 3.25% p.a., or 3.75% p.a. with owner plus at least 2 participants. Plain Tonik Account earns only 0.1% p.a. Rates cut on Oct 19, 2026.
platforms.pdic: Tonik states deposits are insured by PDIC up to PHP 1M per depositor.
platforms.cons: Main account rate is only 0.1%; you must move money into a Stash.

platforms.name: MariBank
platforms.conditions: 3.25% p.a. on balances up to PHP 1,000,000; 3.75% p.a. above PHP 1,000,000. Credited daily, no maintaining balance.
platforms.pdic: MariBank states deposits are insured by PDIC up to PHP 1M per depositor.
platforms.best_for: Shopee users, daily interest with no missions
platforms.cons: Anything above PHP 1M exceeds PDIC cover per bank.

platforms.name: CIMB Bank PH
platforms.conditions: CIMB advisory: 2.30% p.a. on GSave, UpSave, DragonFi Save and CIMB Grow from June 1, 2026. Pre-selected users may get CIMB Grow at a higher rate per GCash Help Center.
platforms.pdic: CIMB Bank PH is a bank; confirm PDIC details in app.
platforms.cons: Base rate below most digital banks now.

platforms.name: Komo
platforms.conditions: Komo savings page advertises 2.5%. Tier details above PHP 500,000 are unverified; check the app.
platforms.pdic: Backed by EastWest; confirm PDIC details in app.
platforms.cons: Lower rate than several digital banks.

platforms.name: Salmon
platforms.conditions: 4% p.a. from Aug 24, 2026, no maintaining balance, interest calculated daily.
platforms.pdic: Not verified on Salmon's page we checked; confirm PDIC cover in app before parking big amounts.
platforms.cons: Smaller, newer bank brand; verify insurance yourself.

platforms.name: OwnBank
platforms.conditions: 3.8% p.a., interest accrues daily, PHP 1 minimum, subject to change at OwnBank's discretion. Basic accounts have a balance limit.
platforms.pdic: Not verified on the page we checked; confirm PDIC cover in app.
platforms.cons: Less known brand; basic account limits.

platforms.name: UNO Digital Bank
platforms.conditions: 3.00% below PHP 5,000; 3.50% from PHP 5,000 to below PHP 5M; 1.00% from PHP 5M. Credited daily. Temporary 1% bonus ended Oct 31, 2026.
platforms.verification: Official page text read via search index; direct fetch was blocked.
